name: Pop's Cafe Hanceville
summary: A 1950s style diner with chrome counters and checkered floors. Regulars love the fluffy pancakes, meatloaf is served every day, and cakes are baked fresh daily. German chocolate is the one people ask for most.

name: Country Wok
summary: Owner Kenny Lee keeps the menu small and sources ingredients locally. New this fall: ramen, Japanese hot dogs, Hong Kong wontons and a matcha cannoli, plus the eggrolls and Korean fried wings. Open Tuesday through Saturday, 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.

name: Hanceville Drug Co Soda Fountain
summary: This soda fountain sits inside a pharmacy that has served Hanceville since 1916. Order a scoop, a sundae, a float, a shake or the famous cherry ice. Bring the kids.

name: Dodge City Restaurant
summary: You'll find it inside the Dodge City Travel Center. Locals and truck drivers both eat here, and the fried cheeseburger has a loyal following.

name: Coffee Hour Co.
summary: A downtown coffee roastery run by a husband and wife. Their walk in tasting room opened in February 2025, and you can order a flight of coffees from around the world.
address: Commercial Street, beside Hanceville Drug Co.

name: Meatloaf Every Day at Pop's
summary: Pop's Cafe has meatloaf every day. Chicken and dumplings, dressing and vegetable soup rotate through the week, and you can call ahead to ask for a dish.

name: Azul Tequila Mexican Cantina
summary: A Mexican cantina on Main Street. Grab a table for tacos and good conversation.

name: Cafe Tula Taqueria
summary: A taqueria on Commercial Street, just a few steps from the downtown shops.

name: Reyes Pizza
summary: Hometown pizza on Main Street, easy to pick up on your way home.

name: HanceVegas Coffee Shop
summary: Downtown coffee with a name that makes people smile.

name: Jack's
summary: Southern burgers and biscuits on Styles Street. A good early breakfast stop.

name: McDonald's
summary: Quick meals on Main Street when the family is in a hurry.

name: Subway
summary: Subs made to order on Main Street.

name: Taco Bell
summary: Tacos and burritos on Main Street.
